shots.text: The Verdant Deep is a forest of trees as tall as towers. The Deepwood live in the branches. Its Warden, Elowen, sleeps in the oldest tree of all, at Sylvanmere.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Giant trees, rope bridges, glow-moss lighting the roots like streets, Deepwood archers.

shots.text: Elowen had gone mad, and the forest could not keep out the Hollow, the dark from behind the Gate. It crept in under the trees. With it came a Herald who sang the dead back onto their feet: the Pale Vesper.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The glow-moss going dark row by row. Pale violet ghost-lights drifting between the roots, and a tall grey-veiled singer with her mouth open: the Pale Vesper.

shots.text: The Deepwood have buried their dead under these trees for a thousand years. Now we know where her army comes from.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin at the edge of a root-road, lantern-pole raised, as grey shapes climb out of the moss.
